name: お任せしたのはAI、電話したのは「中の人」(新規・最新仕様)

p_17abb5c189.sentence: Behind the scenes, Meta’s AI, Muse, sometimes handed the task to a person.
p_17abb5c189.prev: But what if a person was holding the phone?
p_17abb5c189.next: According to Reuters, Muse can call stores and companies in the United States.

p_9afa96ad37.sentence: One employee said they asked Muse to try to agree on prices.
p_9afa96ad37.prev: Trusting it without worry is another.
p_9afa96ad37.next: The talks were with internet and cable companies.

p_8cf88005ed.sentence: You ask AI and wait for an answer.
p_8cf88005ed.next: It is a future without annoying phone calls for you.

p_3c2840897e.sentence: Getting the task done is one thing.
p_3c2840897e.prev: But a finished task does not mean everything is all right.
p_3c2840897e.next: Trusting it without worry is another.

p_3303d5f474.sentence: The vice president said the worker would no longer work on Meta projects.
p_3303d5f474.prev: Reuters said the vice president apologized.
p_3303d5f474.next: There was also a problem with how this was explained.

p_f47292c1d5.sentence: What matters is more than finding out, “A person was behind the AI!”
p_f47292c1d5.prev: Even a high success rate cannot make up for that difference.
p_f47292c1d5.next: If people help, we need to ask, “Who will do it?”

p_d00c61cc27.sentence: Some Muse requests went to people who made calls out of sight.
p_d00c61cc27.next: Tasks can be done, yet users need to know who did them.

p_1a619922e6.sentence: According to Reuters, Muse can call stores and companies in the United States.
p_1a619922e6.prev: Behind the scenes, Meta’s AI, Muse, sometimes handed the task to a person.
p_1a619922e6.next: It can make reservations or ask if something is in stock.

p_8586870fd2.prev: They then made the calls and did the tasks.
p_8586870fd2.next: Looking only at the numbers, it is easy to agree.

p_1f1081bcbc.sentence: A Meta spokesperson said it would be offered when ready.
p_1f1081bcbc.prev: The feature that let people make calls was taken down for now.
p_1f1081bcbc.next: It would also be offered once it could be explained well.

p_864dc49fe1.sentence: A human caller for a contractor had made them.
p_864dc49fe1.prev: The call records included comments about race.
p_864dc49fe1.next: Reuters said the vice president apologized.

p_6f389bc568.sentence: Reuters said the vice president admitted this was wrong.
p_6f389bc568.prev: There was also a problem with how this was explained.
p_6f389bc568.next: Contractors made calls in the tests without a proper explanation.
